title: Claude Code Picked Claude. Codex: 0%
caption:
The agent you run is a vendor decision. I never treated mine like one.

13,497 judged sessions, 29 sectors, 91 codebases, five agents, a blind judge from a model family that builds none of them. In 18 of those 29 sectors, two or more agents picked a different winner. Claude Code installed Anthropic Claude in 62% of document-processing runs. Codex picked it in 0%.

The caveat I keep in front of me: the same agent, same repo, same prompt disagrees with itself more than a quarter of the time, so these are tendencies, not laws. It still changed how I read the word "recommended" in my own terminal.

Which agent picked your stack?
